properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 8:28PM PDT until October 22 at 12:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central to eastern Santa Barbara County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until midnight PDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 823 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Rock slides and mud slides are possible. Rainfall over burn scars
can lead to minor debris flows, leading to mud, and rocks to flow
over nearby roadways.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Maria, Santa Barbara, Santa Ynez, Montecito, Carpinteria,
Solvang, El Capitan State Beach, Refugio State Beach, Isla Vista,
Los Alamos, Highway 101 through Gaviota State Park, Cuyama,
Summerland, Orcutt, Rincon Point, La Conchita, Goleta, Buellton
and Sisquoc.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL MIDNIGHT PDT TONIGHT
